title: Right Answer, Wrong Tokens: Tail-Aware Credit Calibration for RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2607.07976v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Although reinforcement learning (RL) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), GRPO-style methods can suffer from a positive-credit contamination failure mode. Specifically, uniform credit assignment can reinforce locally erroneous tail tokens alongside useful tokens within successful trajectories. To address this problem, we propose Tail-Aware Credit calibratiOn (TACO), which calibrates the positive credit assigned to such tokens without token-level error labels. To this end, TACO lets the policy serve as its own reference, assessing each sampled token's rarity relative to the policy's local expectations to compute a tail-risk score. Using this score as a proxy for potential local errors, TACO softly reduces positive credit for high tail-risk tokens while retaining nonzero weights, limiting their reinforcement without eliminating opportunities to learn useful rare patterns. translated_title: 答案正确，令牌有误：面向可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的尾部感知信用校准
translated_abstract: 尽管强化学习（RL）提升了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但GRPO风格的方法可能会受到“正信用污染”这一失败模式的影响。具体而言，统一的信用分配会在成功的轨迹中，将局部错误的尾部令牌与有用的令牌一同强化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了尾部感知信用校准方法TACO（Tail-Aware Credit calibratiOn），该方法无需令牌级别的错误标签即可校准分配给此类令牌的正信用。为此，TACO让策略自身充当参考基准，通过评估每个采样令牌相对于策略局部期望的稀有程度来计算尾部风险分数。将该分数作为潜在局部错误的代理指标，TACO在保留非零权重的前提下，柔和地降低高尾部风险令牌的正信用，从而在限制强化这些错误令牌的同时，不消除模型学习有用稀有模式的机会。实验在四个LL（后文截断）……
tldr: 针对GRPO类强化学习方法在成功轨迹中会同时强化错误尾部令牌的“正信用污染”问题，论文提出TACO方法，以策略自身为参考计算令牌尾部风险分数，在无需令牌级错误标签的情况下柔和降低高风险令牌的正信用，同时保留学习有用稀有模式的机会。
en_tdlr: TACO tackles positive-credit contamination in GRPO-style RLVR by letting the policy act as its own reference to compute token-level tail-risk scores, softly down-weighting credit for potentially erroneous rare tail tokens without token-level error labels, while still allowing the model to learn genuinely useful rare patterns.
